title: 3914. Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing

examples.explanation: One optimal set of operations: Choose subarray [2..3] and add x = 1 resulting in [3, 3, 3, 2] Choose subarray [3..3] and add x = 1 resulting in [3, 3, 3, 3] The array becomes non-decreasing, and the total sum of chosen x values is 1 + 1 = 2.
One optimal set of operations: Choose subarray [1..3] and add x = 4 resulting in [5, 5, 6, 7] The array becomes non-decreasing, and the total sum of chosen x values is 4.
